title: Girwan Dhakal Profile
content: Girwan Dhakal is a Computer Science researcher and engineer specializing in Agentic Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, and Data Science. He is an Accelerated Master's student at The University of Alabama, graduating May 2027, and is actively seeking Software Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering, and Data Science roles. He builds LLM systems that hold up in production: retrieval agents, OCR data pipelines, and the evaluation tooling that keeps them honest. He is based in Alabama, USA. Email: girwandhakal@gmail.com

title: Technical Skills
content: Girwan's technical skills include: Languages - Python, SQL, C, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript. Frameworks and libraries - PyTorch, Scikit-learn, LangGraph, LangFuse, Promptfoo, React, FastAPI, NumPy, Pandas, Plotly. Tools and platforms - Docker, Git, CI/CD, Airflow, Snowflake, SLURM, Linux, GCP, Power BI, ThoughtSpot.

title: Education
content: Girwan Dhakal studies at The University of Alabama in Tuscaloosa, AL. He is pursuing a Master of Science in Computer Science through the Accelerated Master's Program (August 2024 - May 2027) alongside a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (August 2022 - May 2027).

title: Work Experience: Shipt
content: Data Science Intern on the AI Platform team at Shipt in Birmingham, AL (Jun 2026 - Aug 2026). Built a LangGraph RAG agent that lets AI/ML engineers search internal documentation and manage infrastructure configurations, reducing onboarding and internal support time by 50%. Developed a Gemini-based OCR data pipeline on GCP and Snowflake for previously unprocessed shopper receipts, identifying $10K in projected annual vendor savings while expanding tax-recovery coverage to 99% of collected receipts. Centralized AI platform usage and cost metrics by building scheduled data pipelines into Snowflake and a ThoughtSpot dashboard for company leadership. Improved Mean Reciprocal Rank by 1.6% (0.550 to 0.559) and Recall@K by 20% by tuning Shipt's product substitution-ranking model with Optuna.

title: Work Experience: Alabama Credit Union
content: Data Analyst Co-op at Alabama Credit Union in Tuscaloosa, AL (Aug 2025 - May 2026). Automated recurring workflows with Microsoft Power Automate, eliminating 16 hours of manual reporting every month. Developed and deployed 5 Power BI dashboards with business stakeholders and led weekly user training, increasing dashboard adoption by 50%. Optimized Microsoft SQL Server ETL pipelines, reducing daily refresh time by 30% and delivering fresher data to downstream Power BI dashboards.

title: Work Experience: Alabama Life Research Institute
content: Machine Learning Researcher at Alabama Life Research Institute in Tuscaloosa, AL (Jan 2025 - Present). First-authored a research paper applying machine learning to childhood language development using 60K+ child utterances across multiple longitudinal speech corpora; the manuscript has been submitted for peer review. Benchmarked DeiT, Swin Transformer, and skeleton-based models on 7 hours of child interaction video for gesture classification. Fine-tuned the Google FLAN-T5 large language model on 90K speech utterances, reducing word error rate from 17.2 to 14.4. Diagnosed data leakage in model experiments by auditing train/test splits, classification reports, and validation performance, then rebuilt the evaluation datasets to produce reliable held-out results.

title: Work Experience: RoomiCheck
content: Technical Lead at RoomiCheck in Tuscaloosa, AL (Dec 2025 - Present). Girwan leads engineering on a roommate-matching platform for housing providers, and the team secured $2,500 in non-dilutive funding through RiverPitch 2025 and the 2026 Aldag Entrepreneurship Competition. He built and deployed a FastAPI-based adaptive questionnaire that uses large language models to convert free-text responses into structured roommate profiles, and piloted the system with 50+ users.

title: Project: ClearPath AI Medical Financial Assistant
content: ClearPath is a full-stack medical financial assistant that reconciles bills against EOBs and combines insurance, claims, and Plaid financial data to generate personalized payment and coverage recommendations. Girwan built 20+ REST-style API routes powering cash-flow analysis, cost estimation, and scenario planning, so a patient can see the cheapest route through a medical bill before paying it.

title: Project: Southern Company Fleet Analytics Platform
content: A Python and Streamlit analytics platform for network infrastructure lifecycle management, pairing predictive risk models with a GPT-4o assistant. It won 2nd Place at the UA Innovate Hackathon. Girwan engineered a context-aware GPT-4o assistant over fleet telemetry, integrated predictive failure-risk models, and visualized 1,000+ devices on a 3D geographic risk map.

title: Project: Personal Website Chatbot
content: An interactive portfolio chatbot embedded in Girwan's personal website. It is a retrieval-based Q&A system that answers questions about his background, projects, and skills as his digital persona. Features an iMessage-style UI, semantic ranking over Supabase/pgvector, deterministic guardrails against prompt injection, per-session AES-256-GCM encrypted message logging, a Python safety microservice for PII redaction with Presidio and detect-secrets, and streaming LLM responses.

title: Project: Speech Act Analysis
content: The computational pipeline behind Girwan's first-authored research on childhood language development, modeling 60K+ child utterances drawn from multiple longitudinal speech corpora. He cleaned and modeled complex linguistic datasets, then diagnosed data leakage by auditing train/test splits and classification reports, rebuilding the evaluation sets to produce trustworthy held-out results.
